verses: Then I saw the soul of a woman whose tongue was cut away, and eyes scooped out; and snakes, scorpions, worms, and other noxious creatures (khrafstars) ever devoured the brain of her head; and from time to time, she seized her own body with the teeth, and ever gnawed the flesh.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by this body?'
Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'This is the soul of that wicked woman who was, in her lifetime, an adultress. she also practised much sorcery; and much mischief emanated from her.
